title: How Other Larkspur Table Programmes at a Site Bear on the Vending Services Program
content:
What a client holds elsewhere in the dining programme changes what the vending estate earns and what it may carry.

Where the same client holds an active Unattended Micro Market Program store at the site the machines stand in, the machines carry no fresh food and no hot beverage, because the market already carries both, and the planogram is trimmed at the next refresh. Where a micro market stands at the site, commission accrues only on the machines outside the market room, since machines inside it are part of the market's own settlement rather than the vending statement.

Where the same client holds an active Workplace Cafe Management Program contract at the site, vend prices are set to match the cafe's shelf prices for the same items, and the markup printed against the vending programme is applied only to items the cafe does not carry.

A vending agreement and a micro market at the same site are not mutually exclusive, and many sites hold both; but a vending agreement is never opened at a site where the only demand is inside the market room.

Where the micro market at the site closes, the trimmed planogram is restored at the next refresh and commission accrues on the whole estate from the next statement period.

### Which Vending Services Program programmes each interaction reaches

| Programme | Planogram trimmed where a micro market stands at the site | Vend prices matched to the cafe's shelf prices |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Single Machine Snack Service | yes | yes |
| Snack & Cold Beverage Bank | yes | yes |
| Combination Vending Bank | yes | yes |
| Fresh Food Vending Service | yes | no |
| Campus Vending Network Service | yes | yes |
| Managed Vending & Kiosk Service | no | yes |

### Points of judgement these rules settle

**Which machines a commission accrual reaches where a micro market stands at the site.** Those outside the market room. Machines standing inside the market room are settled through the market rather than through the vending statement.

**What the vending markup still reaches where a cafe contract stands at the site.** Items the cafe does not carry. For items the cafe does carry, the vend price is the cafe's shelf price for the same item.

**Whether a site holding an Unattended Micro Market Program store may hold vending as well.** It may; the two are not mutually exclusive and many sites hold both. What is not done is to open a vending agreement at a site where the only demand is inside the market room.

**What follows when the market at the site closes.** The planogram that was trimmed is restored at the next refresh, and commission accrues on the whole estate from the next statement period — from the next period, not from the day the market closed, and earlier periods are left as they were settled.
